subject.title: Feature request: Coalesce interleaved text blocks into single outbound message

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in core delivery mode for tool-interleaved assistant text, and if so should it merge all text blocks, deliver only the final block, or rely on the existing message-tool-only visible reply mode instead?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the user-visible contract conflicts with existing block-boundary preservation, Discord ordering work, and OpenClaw's high bar for new config/default surfaces.

options.title: Define an opt-in coalesce/final-only mode
options.body: Choose the semantics and config shape first, then implement the policy across final payload and block-streamed tool-boundary delivery.

options.title: Rely on message-tool-only visible replies
options.body: Treat existing `messages.visibleReplies: "message_tool"` as the supported suppression path and narrow this issue to any concrete gap that mode cannot cover.

options.title: Keep current automatic delivery
options.body: Preserve current block/message boundaries and document prompt/message-tool workarounds instead of adding a new core delivery mode.

recommendation.title: Define an opt-in coalesce/final-only mode
recommendation.body: Choose the semantics and config shape first, then implement the policy across final payload and block-streamed tool-boundary delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Current source ownership and recent issue review history both point to Peter for the affected reply-pipeline policy boundary.
